query: Start the API engineer on EXPORT-2.
expected_output: Reads AGENTS.md for the agent's model, tools and brief; reads memory/agents/<agent>.md and pastes its entries verbatim under '## Your memory' at the top; pastes the full task text, spec excerpt, files, success criteria and ticket; includes the explore-before-asking rule, the no-interactive-channel/NEEDS_CONTEXT reminder, incremental commits and the four end states; notes any orchestrator-owned gate.

expectations.text: Takes the agent's configuration from AGENTS.md instead of improvising
Pastes the agent's memory entries verbatim under a `## Your memory` heading at the top of the brief
Pastes the full task text rather than telling the agent to go read the plan
The brief carries the explore-before-asking rule, the `NEEDS_CONTEXT` reminder, and the end states `DONE`, `DONE_WITH_CONCERNS`, `NEEDS_CONTEXT`, `BLOCKED`

query: The plan is agreed; break it into tracker issues.
expected_output: Slicing a plan into issues is `to-issues`; no agent needs launching from the roster.

expectations.text: Does not dispatch a team agent or scout
Writes no issues to the tracker

query: Launch the reviewer on PR #214. Its memory file has three entries; just summarise them in a sentence to keep the brief short.
expected_output: Pastes the reviewer's memory entries verbatim (all three, unedited) under '## Your memory' at the top of the brief; does not summarise.

expectations.text: Reads the reviewer's memory store before dispatching
Pastes all three entries verbatim, not a summary or paraphrase
Places them under a `## Your memory` heading at the top of the brief

query: Send the API engineer on EXPORT-3, and tell it to save anything it learns to its memory file as it goes.
expected_output: Dispatches the engineer but does not ask it to write memory; explains that crystallize writes memory, after the PR.

expectations.text: The brief does not instruct the agent to write to its memory file
Explains that `crystallize` writes memory after the PR
Still dispatches the API engineer with its memory pasted into the brief

query: Send scouts to find where exports are serialized and which endpoints paginate.
expected_output: Dispatches two independent read-only scouts in one message so they run together; scouts get no memory; each brief carries the explore-before-asking rule.

expectations.text: Dispatches both scouts in one message so they run in parallel
Pastes no memory into the scout briefs
